title: BuildSpec
description: An ordered, append-only PATCH LOG of declarative Build ops (TECHSPEC §4, ADR-0006, bh-08a). The renderer FOLDS the log into current geometry: a place adds a piece keyed by id, a move updates an existing id's transform, a delete removes an id (last-write-wins). Interpreted, never executed.

vec3.description: A 3D vector. Marshalled with capital X/Y/Z to mirror Go's domain.Vec3 (no JSON tags).

buildOp.description: One patch-log op. A place introduces a piece keyed by id; a move/delete targets an earlier place's id. Validation runs on the FOLDED result, not per op.

id.description: Stable piece key; move/delete target an earlier place's id.

asset_key.description: Curated Asset catalog key (ADR-0010); the server resolves it to a self-hosted model_ref before the browser sees the op.

part.description: StructureKind a 'module' op builds one step of (milestone 08): foundation|wall|dome|panel|mast|dish. Required with shape 'module'; empty otherwise.
